name: Concrete
description: A 512-piece generative NFT collection whose fallback art is a fingerprint rendered by an onchain neural network.
about:
## Concrete

Concrete is a 512-piece generative NFT collection (an ERC-721A contract) presented by DIID and Higgs. Each token carries a `uint128` seed input, chosen at mint or derived pseudo-randomly from the block timestamp and token ID when left at zero. Every seed is single-use, so no two tokens share the same input.

## Onchain neural network

The contract embeds a small GAN-style generator (`NeuralNetwork.sol`) that runs entirely onchain using fixed-point int16 math: a dense layer, batch normalization, ReLU, and a transposed convolution with a tanh activation. From a seed it produces a tiny 8x12, 24-bit BMP "fingerprint," which is wrapped and upscaled into an 800x1200 pixelated SVG. The model weights are stored via Solady SSTORE2 and are loaded by the owner through `setWeights`.

## Hybrid storage and reveal

A token's `tokenURI` returns an inline JSON data URI. Its image resolves in one of three ways: if the token is unrevealed or has no stored artwork, it shows the fully onchain generative fingerprint; if the owner has stored image chunks via `updateToken`, it serves an onchain SVG built from SSTORE2 data; otherwise it falls back to an off-chain PNG hosted on Firebase Storage, addressed by a stored hash. Token holders can call `setUnrevealed` to switch their own token back to the fingerprint view.

## Dutch-auction mint

Minting used a declining Dutch auction starting at 0.25 ETH and dropping 0.0025 ETH every two hours down to a 0.1 ETH floor, with a hard cap of 512 tokens. The collection is now fully minted (512/512), so `mint` is no longer available.
risks: Owner can call updateToken to change any token's stored image, title, and description at any time
Owner can alter the fingerprint model via setWeights and reschedule the mint via setStartTime
Revealed tokens using the hash path serve their image from centralized Firebase Storage, an availability risk
Contract logic is not upgradeable, and renouncing ownership permanently disables all admin and reveal functions

fingerprintSvg.description: Render the onchain neural-network fingerprint for a seed as an SVG document.

fingerprintUri.title: Fingerprint URI
fingerprintUri.description: Return the onchain fingerprint for a seed as a base64-encoded SVG data URI.

setUnrevealed.title: Set Unrevealed
setUnrevealed.description: Toggle your token between its generative fingerprint and the revealed artwork.
setUnrevealed.warning: Only the token's owner can call this; it changes which image the token displays.

mint.title: Mint
mint.description: Mint a token, generating its onchain fingerprint from the seed input you provide.
mint.deprecated: The collection is fully minted (512/512); minting is no longer available.
mint.warning: Sends ETH equal to the current price; a zero seed derives a pseudo-random one, and each seed is single-use.

updateToken.title: Update Token
updateToken.description: Set a token's onchain image chunks, title, description, or off-chain artwork hash.
updateToken.warning: Only the owner can call this; it can change any token's stored image and metadata.

setWeights.title: Set Weights
setWeights.description: Store a slice of the onchain neural-network weights used to render fingerprints.
setWeights.warning: Only the owner can call this; it alters the model that generates every fingerprint.

setStartTime.title: Set Start Time
setStartTime.description: Set the Unix timestamp when minting begins and the Dutch auction starts.
setStartTime.warning: Only the owner can call this.

withdraw.title: Withdraw
withdraw.description: Withdraw the contract's entire ETH balance to the owner.
withdraw.warning: Only the owner can call this.

transferOwnership.title: Transfer Ownership
transferOwnership.description: Transfer contract ownership and its admin rights to another address.
transferOwnership.warning: Only the owner can call this; the new owner gains full admin control.

renounceOwnership.title: Renounce Ownership
renounceOwnership.description: Permanently give up ownership, leaving the contract without an owner.
renounceOwnership.warning: This is irreversible and disables all admin functions, including future reveals.
